why: Wipro's exchange filing, as reported by Angel One and others, puts the board meeting on 2026-10-14 to 15 with results approved on 2026-10-15 after Indian market hours. This is aggregator coverage of a company filing; the filing itself was not opened. The baseline's 6-K history is not earnings: its dates (06-25, 07-02, 07-20, 07-22) miss the real Q1 print of 2026-07-16.
session_evidence: Results after Indian market close on 2026-10-15; earnings call reported at 7:00 PM IST = 9:30 a.m. ET (https://www.multibagg.ai/market-pulse/articles/wipro-q2-fy27-results-date-cmuy0ka2q00042pl8j86qku19). The release therefore lands before the NYSE open on 10-15, so bmo for the ADR.
where_to_look: Indian IT peers that have already printed Q2 FY27 (TCS, HCLTech, Infosys if out): their BFSI and Europe demand commentary and deal TCV are the read-through to Wipro's guide.
Wipro's large-deal announcements during Q2 (press releases) against its Q2 guide of $2.574 to 2.627bn (-1.5% to +0.5% cc).
The Q3 FY27 guide band is the likely mover; INR/USD over the quarter for margin.
ADR-specific: the ADR is about $1.79 after bonus issues and tracks the NSE line; the US reaction on 10-15 is the overnight gap to the Indian close.
